title: A003: Add minimal GitHub Actions CI workflow
summary: Single 46-line GitHub Actions workflow file (.github/workflows/ci.yaml) with three parallel jobs (lint, test, test-integration), SPDX header, least-privilege permissions, and concurrency control. Accompanied by comprehensive reference documentation (docs/ci-workflow.md). Implementation matches all plan requirements exactly with zero scope creep.

tests_checklist.item: No testable code — infrastructure YAML only
Makefile targets referenced (test, test-integration) exist in CC-0001
go.work file exists at repository root for go-version-file reference

code_quality_checklist.item: YAML is minimal — no unnecessary keys or configuration
Follows DRY — test and test-integration share identical Go setup pattern
No dead code or commented-out sections
Step names are descriptive (Run unit tests, Run integration tests)

security_checklist.item: Permissions: contents: read at top level (least privilege)
Actions pinned to major versions (checkout@v4, setup-go@v5, golangci-lint-action@v9)

architecture_checklist.item: Solution is minimal — single workflow file with 3 jobs
No matrix builds (Makefile handles operator iteration)
No excluded scope items present (no E2E, no Helm, no images, no coverage)
Delegates to Makefile targets rather than inlining build logic
Concurrency group prevents wasted CI resources

dry_yagni_checklist.item: No duplicated configuration — Go setup shared pattern only where needed
No future-proofing (no matrix, no coverage, no E2E)
lint job omits setup-go since golangci-lint-action handles it internally

fail_fast_checklist.item: Jobs run in parallel — no serial bottleneck

suggested_improvements: D4 (minor): docs/ci-workflow.md references conventions from reuse.yaml, deploy-docs.yaml, and mega-linter.yml which do not yet exist on main. These references are forward-looking and document design intent, but could confuse readers until those files are created. Consider adding a note that these are planned conventions.

D2 (minor): Actions are pinned to major versions (v4, v5, v9) rather than full SHA pins. This is acceptable for maintainability but note that SHA pinning (e.g., actions/checkout@<sha>) provides stronger supply-chain security. Consider adopting SHA pins with Dependabot/Renovate comments for future workflows.
next_steps: Merge PR to main — implementation is complete and correct
CC-0001 test-integration Makefile target must be implemented before the test-integration CI job will pass (documented dependency)
When additional workflow files are added (reuse.yaml, deploy-docs.yaml), establish a GitHub Actions workflow conventions pattern
